scope: A10 CDC/SDC formal fix: replace 8 Quartus-21.4-unsupported -quiet with -nowarn in fpga/catapult_a10 SDC; add/adjust EMIF core_usr_clk <-> sys_clk_50 asynchronous CDC, reset/calibration synchronizer, async-FIFO and DDR-core red-path constraints based on T-20260902-019 signoff STA.

changes.summary: Replaced 8 get_clocks/get_registers -quiet with -nowarn; removed unusable set_clock_groups guard; corrected wildcard hierarchy names for soc|emif_adapter FIFO/reset synchronizers; added FIFO memory-data, calibration-gate first-stage, adapter reset synchronizer and documented async control/reset false paths for EMIF core_usr_clk <-> sys_clk_50 and DDR core red paths.

sys_clk_50_hold_negative.root_cause: response_fifo memory read data and gray-pointer source->first-synchronizer paths from EMIF core_usr_clk to sys_clk_50; previous SDC register filters lacked soc|emif_adapter prefix and were ignored by TimeQuest.
sys_clk_50_hold_negative.constraint: wildcarded set_false_path/set_max_delay for FIFO pointers and set_false_path from response_fifo memory to CPU-side read_line_q/response_code_q.

emif_core_usr_clk_setup_recovery_negativ.root_cause: CPU power-on reset/control crossing sys_clk_50 -> EMIF core_usr_clk into EMIF IP and EMIF-side adapter state/response FIFO memory.
emif_core_usr_clk_setup_recovery_negativ.constraint: set_false_path from reset_gate_inst|logic_rst_n_q to emif|emif_bot|*, soc|emif_adapter|emif_req_q*, response_fifo/* and request_fifo/*.

sys_clk_50_removal_ddr_core_negative.root_cause: EMIF status/reset sync and adapter raw cal_fail/cpu_domain_rst control paths into CPU domain; same paths also appear in DDR Core report.
sys_clk_50_removal_ddr_core_negative.constraint: calibration_gate first-stage false paths, EMIF IP -> CPU-domain soC/adapter register false paths; raw cal_fail RTL sync still required.

remote_static_validation.result: READ_SDC_OK, 0 errors, 0 warnings (no ignored-filter/empty-collection warnings after corrected wildcards)

known_limits: SDC exceptions model the current asynchronous control/reset structure; they are not a functional CDC signoff.

RTL still uses raw cal_fail in CPU-side adapter state and CPU reset directly in EMIF-side FSM/reset; per-domain reset and synchronized status consumption must be fixed separately before Gate F-MEM/F-BOARD.
No full STA rerun was performed; expected next verification is the FP-P3T + FP-P5 rerun using this SDC.
next: Register FP-P3T for fp_exec/scalar_unit critical path.
Create RTL CDC hardening task for adapter/calibration_gate synchronized cal_failed_cpu and per-domain EMIF-side reset release.
After both, rerun FP-P4 functional and FP-P5 synthesis/fitter/signoff STA; only non-negative setup/hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse permits assembler/SOF.

integrator_review.notes: A10 SDC/CDC fix merged and accepted
